messages:
maria: Morning — quick async thread for the rollforward stability sweep. TL;DR: 5% traffic rolled to v2 last night, minor latency blip during one window, otherwise healthy.

ajay: Nice. What time did the blip show up and which region?

maria: ~02:14 UTC in us-central1. p95 went from 180ms to ~420ms for ~3m, p99 spiked to 1.1s.

sophia: I pulled traces — looks like a retry storm from a downstream cache miss during a KV eviction. Trace IDs: `trace/ab12ef`.

kevin: Thanks — I patched the client backoff on the fallback path (PR #492). Can we keep the ramp paused at 5% while we watch?

maria: Yes pause is in place. Can someone run a quick regression on generation quality for the sample prompt set? @tara can you coord with QA? :eyes:

tara: On it. Kicking off eval job now, will post results. ETA ~25m.

qa-bot: Eval job started: `evals/rollforward-sanity-2026-03-17-01` — running 120 prompts across 3 personas.

ajay: Also FYI deploy-bot reported one failed instance restart around the blip window in us-central1-lake. Might be transient OOM on a hot shard.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment v2 -> service-inference: started at 2026-03-17T01:40Z, 5% traffic, target regions = [us-central1, eu-west1]. Instance restart detected on instance inf-7-usc at 2026-03-17T02:16Z (exit code 137).

kevin: Exit 137 = OOM. I added a guard to evict large KV entries earlier in the request lifecycle in my patch. Will monitor memory graphs.

maria: Action items: 1) keep ramp = 5% (done), 2) kevin to monitor memory + increase soft limit if stable, 3) tara/QA to run quality evals, 4) sophia to validate traces and link any suspect spans to the retry patch.

ajay: For observability, I've opened a quick dashboard: /dashboards/rollforward-stability-sweep — includes p50/p95/p99, errors, instance restarts, and retry counts. Share if you need access.

kevin: I'll tail `kubectl logs -n inference inf-7-usc` and post key log snippets if anything else pops.

maria: If QA passes and memory stabilizes for 30m, propose we go to 20% tomorrow morning US window. If any new 5xx or >500ms p95 persists, we abort and roll back.

tara: QA update: initial eval results: 120 prompts -> quality diffs: 3 flagged for reduced factuality, 1 formatting regression. Detailed report at: https://redwood-internal/reports/rollforward-eval-360501. Will consolidate notes in ~15m.

kevin: Re logs: saw a sharp spike in local cache misses right before the eviction. Patch PR: `github.com/redwood/inference/pull/492` (guard + backoff). Rolling to a small canary of 2 instances to validate.

ajay: Suggest also enabling `auto-fallback: true` for the affected route — keeps user requests served by v1 if v2 shows errors. Can we toggle that config?

maria: We can. I'm enabling `auto-fallback` for route /generate now. Command: `rictl routes update /generate --auto-fallback=true`

deploy-bot: Route update accepted. auto-fallback=true applied to /generate for service-inference.

sophia: I'll map trace IDs to the retry code paths and annotate the dashboard.

maria: Thanks team. Check-ins: post back here with QA verdict and a memory graph screenshot. If green for 30m, we schedule 20% ramp at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Otherwise rollback plan: deploy v1 weights and open a postmortem.

kevin: Posting initial memory graph: https://wavefront.link/graphs/inf-7-usc-memory?from=-60m — looks like memory returns to baseline after GC at 02:20Z.

tara: QA final: majority pass. 3 minor fidelity flags captured and added to tracking ticket INF-754. No severe regressions. Recommend proceed to 20% in AM.

maria: Consensus = proceed. I'll create the rollout calendar entry and notify SRE for the 09:00 window. Adding the post-rollout monitoring playbook link: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/rollouts/stability-sweep. :white_check_mark:

ajay: One last note — remind support to enable verbose logging for the first hour after ramp, set retention to 24h for quick forensics.

maria: Will do. Thanks everyone — ping here if anything changes.

kevin: Thanks.

sophia: 👍

tara: 💪

deploy-bot: Canary traffic at 5% unchanged. Monitoring OK as of 2026-03-17T03:05Z.
